contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 13
acceptance_criteria: Only Rework 13 is executable and only the two authorized test files may change; every production file remains byte-identical unless a new product defect is separately proven and authorized.
Use independent controlled values for viewport width 1536px, Sidebar width 164px, expected Main width 1372px, Executive horizontal inset 24px plus 24px and expected Executive content width 1324px.

Independently model Main clientWidth, Main scrollWidth, Executive border-box or client width and the Executive horizontal start or external offset; do not assign Executive width from Main clientWidth.
Prove Main clientWidth equals 1372px, Main scrollWidth equals Main clientWidth, the Executive right edge does not exceed Main and the 24px plus 24px inset remains internal through border-box sizing.
A deliberately oversized Executive fixture and a deliberately positive external-offset fixture each fail the same fit predicate used for the valid 1536px model.

Retain the deterministic 1024px viewport model with 164px Sidebar, Main clientWidth 860px, Main scrollWidth 1100px and maximum Main scrollLeft 240px; prove complete horizontal reachability through Main.

Independently model document.documentElement and document.body with scrollWidth equal to clientWidth so neither owns additional horizontal overflow; a deliberately invalid Body-overflow fixture must fail the ownership predicate.

Test names or adjacent comments explicitly state that jsdom controlled DOM dimensions are deterministic layout-contract verification and not native browser pixel measurement; Product Owner live browser acceptance at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom remains required.
WorkspaceSwitcher discoverability remains passing with 11px semibold identity, visible background, border, padding, Chevron, hover and focus states and canonical setWorkspace to navigate behavior.

The real cross-workspace integration regression remains passing for / to /executive to / with real SOCWorkspace, SOC Dashboard, ExecutiveWorkspace and Executive Overview composition and no generic workspace doubles.

WorkspaceOutlet.tsx, every production layout or navigation file, Rework 11 Defect A and the complete Rework 10 visual, routing, truthful-data, UTF-8 and no-provider behavior remain unchanged and passing.
Focused PlatformLayout and ExecutiveLayout tests, existing WorkspaceSwitcher and real cross-workspace integration tests and focused Rework 10 SOC preservation tests pass.
The full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass and Scope Guard confirms only the exact two authorized test files changed.
The immutable reference remains .ai/references/TASK-0122-product-owner-mockup.png with SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df.
Do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
